# Changelog

This page records notable changes to the Vault Administration Guide.

## 2026-11

- Added field-validated guidance from HashiCorp Professional Services delivery: identity provider prerequisites, LDAP and SAML common issues, break-glass access and user lockout; JWT auth for CI/CD platforms and AppRole and cert auth caveats; namespace design; KV v2 policy paths; database and LDAP secrets engine gotchas; Transit large payloads; SIEM planning and operational logs; in-place upgrade order; snapshot restore on the leader; and operations runbooks.

## 2026-08

- Restructured legacy Vault HVD content into the HVD 2.0 Vault Administration Guide as part of the Installation / Administration / User guide migration.

## 2026-06

- Add production hardening guide to prerequisites

## 2026-01

- Update meta descriptions
- Updated credits and contributors
